info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Salesforce REST API
Versions
Salesforce Experience Cloud List Available API Versions

items.docs: Returns a list of all available REST API versions, including the version number, label, and a link to each version's root resource. This endpoint does not require authentication.

info.name: Resources
Salesforce Experience Cloud List Available Resources

items.docs: Returns a list of resources available for the specified API version, providing the name and URI of each resource. Useful for discovering available endpoints.

info.name: Describe
Salesforce Experience Cloud Describe Global

items.docs: Returns a list of all sObjects available in the org, including metadata about each object such as label, name, key prefix, and available operations (createable, queryable, etc.).

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Describe an sObject

params.name: sObjectName
params.description: The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., Account, Contact)

items.docs: Returns complete metadata about the specified sObject, including all fields, record types, child relationships, URLs, and supported operations. Includes field-level details such as type, length, picklist values, and relationship information.

info.name: sObjects
Salesforce Experience Cloud Get sObject Basic Information

params.name: sObjectName
params.description: The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., Account, Contact)

items.docs: Returns metadata about the specified sObject, including the object describe result and recently accessed records of that type.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Create an sObject Record

params.name: sObjectName
params.description: The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., Account, Contact)

items.docs: Creates a new record for the specified sObject type. The request body must contain the field values for the new record.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get an sObject Record

params.name: sObjectName
params.description: The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., Account, Contact)

params.name: recordId
params.description: The 15 or 18 character Salesforce record ID

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of field names to return

items.docs: Returns the field values for the specified record. Use the fields parameter to specify which fields to return. If no fields are specified, all accessible fields are returned.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Update an sObject Record

params.name: sObjectName
params.description: The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., Account, Contact)

params.name: recordId
params.description: The 15 or 18 character Salesforce record ID

items.docs: Updates the specified record with the provided field values. Only fields included in the request body are updated.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Delete an sObject Record

params.name: sObjectName
params.description: The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., Account, Contact)

params.name: recordId
params.description: The 15 or 18 character Salesforce record ID

items.docs: Deletes the specified record. The record is moved to the Recycle Bin unless permanently deleted.

info.name: Query
Salesforce Experience Cloud Execute a SOQL Query

params.name: q
params.value: SELECT Id, Name FROM Account LIMIT 10
params.description: The SOQL query string to execute

items.docs: Executes a SOQL query and returns the matching records. Supports standard SOQL syntax including SELECT, FROM, WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMIT, and OFFSET clauses. Returns paginated results with a nextRecordsUrl for large result sets.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Execute a SOQL Query Including Deleted Records

params.name: q
params.description: The SOQL query string to execute

items.docs: Executes a SOQL query and returns matching records including deleted and archived records. Otherwise behaves identically to the standard query endpoint.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get Next Page of Query Results

params.name: queryLocator
params.description: Query locator from the previous query result

items.docs: Retrieves the next page of results for a previously executed SOQL query using the query locator from the nextRecordsUrl.

info.name: Search
Salesforce Experience Cloud Execute a SOSL Search

params.name: q
params.value: FIND {test} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name)
params.description: The SOSL search string to execute

items.docs: Executes a SOSL search query and returns matching records across multiple objects. SOSL supports full-text search with wildcard and phrase matching.

info.name: Limits
Salesforce Experience Cloud Get Org Limits

items.docs: Returns the current API usage limits for the org, including daily API request limits, data storage, file storage, and other governor limits. Useful for monitoring API consumption.
